what: An unofficial Ensoniq SQ-80, written from scratch: three wavetable oscillators, a resonant 4-pole filter, four envelopes and three LFOs per voice, eight voices, effects, an arpeggiator and a sequencer. 75 waves of its own; load your own SQ-80 ROMs and SysEx banks if you have them.
author: Leonardo Lopez Chavira

smk37.what: An unofficial Ensoniq SQ-80, written from scratch, for the SMK-37 keyboards: wavetable oscillators, a 4-pole filter, four envelopes, three LFOs, eight voices, effects, arpeggiator and sequencer. 75 waves of its own; load your own SQ-80 ROMs and SysEx banks if you have them.
